message.abstract: <jats:title>Résumé</jats:title><jats:p>A known consequence of the theorem of the algebraic subgroup is a lower bound for the rank of matrices whose entries are linear combinations, with algebraic coefficients, of logarithms of algebraic numbers. We extend this kind of result to commutative algebraic groups.</jats:p>
